name: Taiyou no Promia Flowering Days
original_name: 太陽のプロミア　Flowering Days
source:
This is the fandisk for Taiyou no Promia, taking place a few months after the closure of the original. Kodama gets to spend his summer with the ‘six flowers’ (and Promia) at Reno-Leno’s suggestion.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《太阳的普罗米娅》的Fan Disc，故事发生在本篇落幕后数月。应里诺·雷诺的提议，柯达玛得以与“六花”（以及普罗米娅）共同度过这个夏天。

[内容取自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
